description: Prove the address with the 6-digit code emailed by sign_up. Without a key on the connection, pass the email too: on success this returns the API key (shown once). Turns on email notifications.

email.description: Required when not yet connected with a key

preset.description: Named scope bundle: full (everything), wiring (forms only, no submission access), readonly, triage

scopes.description: Explicit scopes, instead of a preset. Ignored where it would exceed the calling key's own scopes.

name: verify_account
title: Verify the account email
